name: Raid Manager
description: ZDPS-compatible raid coordination HUD — pull countdown, raid warnings, and savable dungeon marker presets.
author: Stellar

added: Mark Presets — save the markers you place in a dungeon and reload the whole layout in one click. Build a preset as a sequence of steps (one layout per phase) and move through them with Previous / Reset / Next during the fight, with a separate preset for each raid.
fixed: The countdown and raid-warning text is readable again — it had been showing far too small.
